{{Quote|Remain in the garden as long as you like. Being around all of this&hellip; often clears my head.|King Alaric|<ref name="JY" />}}
The '''royal garden''' of [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric]], [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]], was located in [[Alaric's palace|his palace]]. It notably hosted a [[Century flower|rare species]] of [[Flower/Legends|flowers]] which came from the other side of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Alaric was very fond of his [[Garden/Legends|garden]], and he insisted on preserving the fragile harmony of its eco-system.<ref name="JY" />
